system.description:
Powerful elders usually stand alone, but when the lead begins to fly it is often wiser to lend your own resilience to a servant or ally than to face the storm unaided.

Spend a Willpower Trait and mark the target with a drop of your vitae, then spend one Blood Trait per level of Fortitude you wish to grant and win a Static Physical Challenge against three times the Blood Traits spent. Success bestows that many levels of Fortitude on the target for the rest of the night (only the net increase counts if they already possess some); failure allows a Survival retest. Only one instance of this power may be active on a given target at a time.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait per level of Fortitude granted, per target, plus One Willpower Trait
